Build your career at SCOR Bucharest, where top Romanian and international talent shape the future of reinsurance business, finance and technology – keeping SCOR at the forefront of innovation worldwide.
   At SCOR, we combine the Art and Science of risk to help build more resilient societies. Technology is a vital resource and partner in every step of our journey. We are seeking innovators to join our dynamic tech team of over 200 professionals across three global hubs. Guided by our corporate values--Collaboration, Courage, Care, Open-Mindedness, and Integrity--our teams develop technology that insures the world. Join us and make a difference! As the Senior Data Platform Engineer you will be a reliable team-player, problem-solving oriented with strong analytical thinking. You will contribute to the development, maintenance and continuous improvement of SCORs enterprise data platforms, including Databricks, Palantir Foundry and associated cloud services.Working closely with Data Engineers, Architects and Platform Leads, you will help provide a secure, scalable and easy-to-use platform experience by implementing automation, operational controls, monitoring capabilities, services as well as reusable components that accelerate data delivery across the Group.Key duties and responsibilities :Under the responsibility of a Data Platform Lead, your mission will be to:Build, maintain and support data platform capabilities that enable data engineers and analytics teams to deliver solutions efficiently.Develop automation assets including deployment pipelines, SDLC accelerators, monitoring tools and operational frameworks.Contribute to platform administration activities, including access management, environment configuration and operational support.Build observability services and use them to monitor the data platform, helping identify issues and participate in remediation activities.Document platform artefacts such as technical standards, pipelines, services, runbooks.Collaborate with platform architects and engineering teams to ensure alignment with enterprise standards and best practices.Support platform adoption by contributing to reusable templates, accelerators and self-service capabilities.Participate in technology watch activities to evaluate and leverage relevant platform innovations.Required experience &
